intro: Kovan Wellspring is an HDB project in Hougang. A tracker month of October 2026 was previously noted in our file and has been withdrawn: it was not a verified completion month, and public HDB roadshow and virtual-tour resources do not date completion or keys. The key date is unconfirmed, and this project is not officially confirmed, so unit counts and any completion month are left out of the facts below. If you already have an HDB key-appointment letter, that is the date we will work from. If you do not, we will not invent one. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Kovan Wellspring renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Kovan Wellspring interior
sections.text:
Kovan is a settled north-eastern neighbourhood with its own town-centre grain, distinct from other parts of Hougang. Owners approaching keys typically need the flat to work immediately: fitted kitchen cabinets, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, rather than a temporary set of loose furniture. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, photographed professionally, including closer material studies when you need to decide on a finish. We do not use IKEA-style furniture as the backbone of the home. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Kovan Wellspring layout.

Tanjong Tree Residences @ Hougang, listed at Hougang Street 13, is the other Hougang page in this batch and is also unconfirmed for keys; do not copy a date from one page to the other. We will not invent walking times to Kovan MRT or to Hougang town. Check your own block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a window bench or any hacking.

When a key date is in writing, inspect defects, measure, and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and key letter if you have them. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.q: Do you have the Kovan Wellspring floor plan?

faq.q: Do I need an HDB renovation permit?
faq.a: Yes, for the usual HDB renovation works. After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the permit with a registered contractor before carpentry is fabricated.
Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
